status: Research design frozen; implementation/runtime registration pending orchestration benchmark
selection_rule: Every W field with real mean above fixed45-column baseline and positive matched gains in each fold mean and each model-seed mean. Exploratory selection on pre2019 development only.
fixed_backbone: R8w source-college41 + real dated consensus4; TabICL32, same source/labels/canonical order/tie handling

arms_per_pair.RP: A real; B shuffled within cohort/role/missingness,3x3
arms_per_pair.PP: Whole two-column vectors shuffled within cohort/role/joint missingness, preserving pair distribution,3x3

mandatory_replay_gate: All18 W reference tasks must exactly reproduce raw/canonical predictions and scores before interpretation.
slot_policy: Singles use unchanged W slot041 and46 columns. Pairs use fixed slots041/042 and47 columns; alphabetical feature assignment. Real/control pair widths identical.
comparison: Both RR-minus-RP and RR-minus-PR conditional gains, with joint RR-minus-PP separately. Report fold and seed variation and actual RR change relative to baseline and both unchanged single-feature means. Cross-feature dependence can be broken by conditional shuffles; these are usability diagnostics, not conditional-randomization significance tests.
exploratory_complement_candidate_rule: Positive mean conditional gains for both features, positive means in every development fold, and actual pair mean exceeding each W single-feature mean. No automatic promotion; report all10 pairs, including failed gates.
no_model_changes_for_speed: Only the independently benchmarked scheduler/worker count may change; predictor/data/seed settings remain fixed.
